scope: Read-only fact review against retained pair analysis, run declarations, geometry-capture summaries/corrections, and recording-review evidence; no reruns or scientific-input changes.

actions: Changed the 10-second description from a declared initialization duration to an analysis boundary.
Clarified 56/59 as complete breaths after excluding the boundary-spanning cycle; raw counter increments after the boundary are 57/60.
Narrowed footer clipping to lung/final views; removed the unsupported heart-view clipping claim.
Embedded a retained native whole-body final frame.

findings.basis: The 310-second declarations pin 155000 steps at dt 0.002 and release initialization, but do not declare a 10-second initialization interval. The 10-second point is the analysis boundary. Counter changes after that boundary are 57 baseline and 60 intervention; excluding the breath spanning the boundary gives 56 and 59 complete post-boundary breaths. The 350 cardiac cycles are post-boundary (12 at step 5000, 362 at step 155000).

The later root re-review found lower footer prefixes clipped in lung and terminal/final views, while the heart frame was left-aligned and did not support a clipping claim. An earlier visual-review receipt says heart/lung; the README disposition follows the later re-review and narrows the claim.

The current README correctly limits the geometry result to eight sampled accepted captures, 859 declared targets, skin self/invalid checks, and selected muscle surfaces 63/64; it does not claim all-step or whole-body anatomy acceptance. Both capture summaries and retained correction sidecars confirm the eight-step schedule.

The README correctly says criteria were unchanged before intervention launch while baseline was already running. The chronology correction identifies that criteria were not pinned before baseline start.

conclusion: The two concrete wording mismatches identified in the reviewed README were corrected by root before publication. No further blocking factual discrepancy was identified in this bounded review.
